name: CCA 101 地面障碍 沙暴双发失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 101 at Beijing Airport, your parking bay is 531 with information Sierra, request ATC clearance to HongKong.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Beijing Airport 的 Air China 101，停机位 531，收到信息 Sierra，请求前往 HongKong 的 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CCA101, bay 531, information S, request ATC clearance to HongKong.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CCA101，531 号停机位，信息 S，请求前往 HongKong 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 101, cleared to HongKong via flight planned route, runway 36L, RENOB 02 departure, initial altitude 900 meters, expect en-route altitude 10 minutes after departure, departure frequency 119.65. Call me ready for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，可以按计划航路前往 HongKong，跑道 36L，RENOB 02 离场，初始高度 900 米，预计离场后 10 分钟给途中高度，离场频率 119.65。准备推出和开车时呼叫我。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to HongKong via flight planned route, runway 36L, RENOB 02 departure, initial altitude 900m, expect en-route altitude 10min after departure, departure frequency 119.65, CCA101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 HongKong，跑道 36L，RENOB 02 离场，初始高度 900 米，预计离场后 10 分钟给途中高度，离场频率 119.65，CCA101。

cards.audioText:
B: You are now at the holding point of runway 36R.
C: Air China 101, behind the departing Airbus 330, cross runway 36R behind, then taxi via Echo and hold short of runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh:
B: 你现在在跑道 36R 等待点。
C: Air China 101，在离场 Airbus 330 后面，跟在其后穿越跑道 36R，然后经 Echo 滑行并在跑道 36L 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Behind A330, cross runway 36R behind, taxi via E and hold short of runway 36L, CCA101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟在 A330 后面，在其后穿越跑道 36R，经 E 滑行并在跑道 36L 前等待，CCA101。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing, you observed a cone marker in front of you on the taxiway Echo, you have stopped the aircraft, report the situation to ATC and confirm if the taxiway Echo is closed.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 滑行中，你在滑行道 Echo 前方看到一个锥形标志，你已停住飞机，向 ATC 报告情况并确认滑行道 Echo 是否关闭。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA101, a cone marker in front of us on the taxiway E, we have stopped, is the taxiway E closed ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA101，滑行道 E 上我们前方有一个锥形标志，我们已停住，滑行道 E 是否关闭？

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 101, negative, taxiway Echo is fully open, are you able to taxi around it?
B: Tell ATC that you are unable to taxi around it and request ground personnel to remove it.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 101，否，滑行道 Echo 完全开放，你能绕过它滑行吗？
B: 告诉 ATC 你无法绕过它，请求地面人员移除。
cards.referenceText: We are unable to taxi around it, request ground personnel to remove it, CCA101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们无法绕过它，请求地面人员移除，CCA101。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 101, roger, hold present position.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，收到，原地等待。

cards.audioText:
B: Several minutes later.
C: Air China 101, Ground, the safety officer confirms the taxiway is now clear, continue on Echo and hold short of runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh:
B: 几分钟后。
C: Air China 101，地面，安全员确认滑行道现在已清空，继续在 Echo 上滑行并在跑道 36L 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue on E and hold short of runway 36L, CCA101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续在 E 上滑行并在跑道 36L 前等待，CCA101。

cards.audioText: B: You are now at the holding point of runway 36L, tell ATC that you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在跑道 36L 等待点，告诉 ATC 你准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA101, holding point of runway 36L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA101，跑道 36L 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 101, behind landing traffic line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，在着陆交通后面，跟在后面进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Behind landing traffic line up behind, CCA101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在着陆交通后面进跑道，CCA101。

cards.audioText: B: It is much later, you initiate approach, you have reached 15000 meters and request further descent, call HongKong Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 很久以后，你开始进近，已到达 15000 米并请求继续下降，呼叫 香港进近。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Approach, CCA101, maintain 15000m, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，CCA101，保持 15000 米，请求继续下降。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 101, maintain 15000 meters, opposite traffic 2 o’clock 10 miles, report clear of traffic.
B: Tell the controller you are clear of the other aircraft and request to fly lower.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 101，保持 15000 米，相对交通 2 点钟方向 10 海里，报告脱离交通。
B: 告诉管制员你已脱离另一架飞机，并请求降低高度。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Approach, CCA101, clear of traffic, request to fly lower.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，CCA101，脱离交通，请求降低高度。

cards.audioText: B: You were cleared to 5000 meters but notice the sky turning dark and visibility is getting worse quickly, you suspect a sand storm. Tell HongKong Approach this situation and ask ATC if there is a sandstorm forecast.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你获准下降到 5000 米，但注意到天空变暗、能见度迅速变差，你怀疑有沙尘暴。向香港进近说明情况，并询问 ATC 是否有沙尘暴预报。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Approach, CCA101, the sky turning dark and visibility is getting worse quickly, we suspect a sandstorm, is there a sandstorm forecast ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，CCA101，天空变暗，能见度迅速变差，我们怀疑有沙尘暴，是否有沙尘暴预报？

cards.audioText: B: The sandstorm is very severe and visibility is now very poor. Inform ATC the situation and ask to climb to a higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 沙尘暴非常严重，现在能见度很差。通知 ATC 情况，并请求爬升到较高高度以越过沙尘暴。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Approach, CCA101, the sandstorm is very severe and visibility is now very poor, request climb to a higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，CCA101，沙尘暴非常严重，现在能见度很差，请求爬升到较高高度以越过沙尘暴。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 101, climb and maintain 7000 meters and turn right heading 210.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，爬升并保持 7000 米，右转航向 210。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 7000m，turn right heading 210, CCA101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 7000 米，右转航向 210，CCA101。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, your No.1 and No.2 engines have flamed out due to the dust storm, request radar vectors to HongKong Airport for priority landing. This is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 突然，由于沙尘暴，你的 1 号和 2 号发动机熄火，请求雷达引导至 HongKong Airport 优先着陆。这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, HongKong Approach, CCA101, our No.1 and No.2 engines have flamed out due to the dust storm, request radar vectors to HongKong Airport for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，香港进近，CCA101，由于沙尘暴，我们的 1 号和 2 号发动机熄火，请求雷达引导至 HongKong Airport 优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 101, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 260, this will take you direct to HongKong, the weather at HongKong Airport is clear.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 101，收到 Mayday，右转航向 260，这将使你直飞 HongKong，HongKong Airport 天气晴好。
